leads.inquiry_text: We are setting up an AAV vector QC workflow and need a density gradient system for small-batch purification and fraction collection. Please share PW-G100 configuration, delivery time, and budgetary pricing.

We distribute life science instruments in Spain and Portugal. We are interested in representing PW-G100 for exosome isolation and viral particle separation customers. Please send distributor terms and demo unit options.

Our lab studies extracellular vesicles from cell culture media. We want to compare density gradient workflows with ultracentrifugation. Could PW-G100 support exosome isolation for research-scale samples?
We are evaluating systems for AAV purification before process scale-up. Need technical specifications, GMP-adjacent documentation, warranty, and a formal quotation for PW-G100 with modules.

We are preparing a government procurement request for a density gradient separation system for virus-like particles and extracellular vesicles. Please provide compliance documents and estimated lead time.
